items.entity: design domain physical size, orientation and element size
items.description: Table 3 gives only 'Mesh 80×40, n_e=3200'. The paper never states the physical lengths L_x and L_y, even though Sec. 3.4 asks for LLM coordinates in [0,L_x]×[0,L_y]. Element size, aspect ratio and plane-stress thickness are also missing, and 80-along-x is only implied. For a 2D compliance solve this has no effect if elements are square and r_min and region coordinates are in element units. It does matter if they are physical lengths.
readings: L_x × L_y = 80 × 40 with unit square elements (nelx=80 horizontal, nely=40 vertical), unit thickness
normalized 2 × 1 domain (element size 0.025), filter radius still in element units
normalized 1 × 0.5 domain (element size 0.0125)

items.entity: mid-right load
items.description: Table 3 (ID 3) says only 'mid-right load' and gives no direction anywhere. Because the void placement is unknown, the problem may not be symmetric about mid-height, so flipping the sign may do more than mirror the layout.
readings: vertical, downward (−y)
vertical, upward (+y)

items.entity: mid-right load
items.description: No magnitude is given. Sec. 4.3 only says quantities are nondimensionalized with E0=1. The reported C≈91.5/115.2 look consistent with a unit load. In a fixed minimum-compliance rerun, the magnitude only scales C by F². In the original loop it would also shift results against the absolute σ_yield=120.3 gate, which changes the controller's actions.
readings: F = 1 (unit load)

items.entity: mid-right load
items.description: Table 3 does not say whether 'mid-right load' is a point load or a distributed load. Other rows say 'point' or 'distributed' explicitly, and the Table 2 load-outside-void check refers to point loads. With nely=40 there is a node exactly at mid-height.
readings: single nodal point load at the right-edge node at y = 0.5 L_y
load spread over 3 nodes (≈0.05 L_y patch) centred at y = 0.5 L_y on the right edge

items.entity: Poisson's ratio
items.description: Only E0=1 (Sec. 4.3) and plane stress (Table 3, Sec. 3.3) are given. ν is never stated.

items.entity: void stiffness / minimum density in the compliance solve
items.description: The solver uses K_e = ρ_e^p K_e^0 with an OC lower bound ρ_min, and voids are locked at ρ_min (Sec. 3.2, 3.5, Eq. 6), but ρ_min is never given. The only stated floor is E_min = 1e-9 E0 in Eq. 2, which is used for the stress pass, not the solver.
readings: pure SIMP with ρ_min = 1e-3
modified SIMP E = E_min + ρ^p(E0−E_min), E_min = 1e-9 E0
pure SIMP with ρ_min = 1e-9

items.entity: the two benchmark passive voids
items.description: Table 3 only says '2 voids', and Sec. 3.5 allows circular or rectangular regions. The text never gives their shape, size or centre positions; they are visible only in Fig. 2.
readings: two equal circles, radius ≈0.125 L_y (5 elements), centred at (1/3 L_x, 1/2 L_y) and (2/3 L_x, 1/2 L_y)
two equal circles, radius ≈0.15 L_y, stacked at x = 1/2 L_x, y = 1/4 L_y and 3/4 L_y
two circles, radius ≈0.125 L_y, staggered at (1/3 L_x, 0.3 L_y) and (2/3 L_x, 0.7 L_y)
two rectangles ≈0.1 L_x × 0.25 L_y centred at (1/3 L_x, 1/2 L_y) and (2/3 L_x, 1/2 L_y)

items.entity: reference volume of the volume constraint when passive voids are present
items.description: Sec. 3.2 states V(ρ) ≤ v_f V0, and Sec. 3.5 locks voids at ρ_min and excludes them from OC. The text does not say whether v_f is taken over all 3200 elements or only over the designable (non-void) elements.
readings: v_f relative to all 3200 elements (void elements count as empty)
v_f relative to the non-void designable elements only

items.entity: volume fraction of the soft-seed state (Fig. 2 right, C=115.2)
items.description: Table 3 gives v_f=0.25 as the initial target. Table 14 reports a soft-seed final target of 0.28 for this problem in all repeats. The fixed-volume run at v_f=0.25 (Table 6) gives C=134.64, not 115.2. Sec. 3.5 and Fig. 2 do not say which v_f the shown state uses.

items.entity: volume fraction of the passive-solid state (Fig. 2 left, C=91.5)
items.description: No final volume target is reported for the passive-solid condition; Table 14 covers only the soft-seed and rule-based runs, and the controller can change v_f. If C scales roughly as 1/v_f, going from C=115.2 at 0.28 to C=91.5 implies v_f≈0.35.
readings: ≈0.35 (controller-raised target)

items.entity: frozen-solid elements in the volume constraint (Fig. 2 left)
items.description: Sec. 3.5 says frozen elements 'are counted in the reported physical volume-fraction check, but they are not redistributed by the OC bisection'. It is unclear whether the frozen volume is subtracted from the free elements' target or added on top of v_f.
readings: total (free + frozen) volume = v_f·N; OC bisection on free elements targets v_f·N − N_frozen
OC bisection enforces v_f on free elements only; frozen material is extra (total > v_f)

items.entity: LLM-placed frozen solid regions (Fig. 2 left)
items.description: Per Sec. 3.5 and the Fig. 2 caption, the passive-solid panel comes from a trace whose action sequence differs from the soft-seed trace. The text never gives the number, action type (hotspot circle, widen-member circle chain, redistribute), radius or centre of the frozen regions, and Table 1 gives no region sizes.
readings: single circle, radius ≈3 elements (≈0.075 L_y), centred on the peak-stress solid element at a clamped root corner (x≈0, y≈0 or y≈L_y)
single circle, radius ≈3 elements, at the load-introduction zone near (L_x, 0.5 L_y)
overlapping chain of circles (radius ≈2 elements) along a stressed upper or lower chord from root to load (widen-member action)
circle or rectangle at a member–void junction next to a benchmark void, paired with a void in a low-stress zone (redistribute action)
two to four such regions accumulated over up to 5 design steps

items.entity: LLM-placed soft-seed regions / initial density field (Fig. 2 right)
items.description: Sec. 3.5 does not report which spatial actions were applied in the soft-seed trace, or the seed shapes, radii and centres. Fig. 2 shows only the retained-best result, so seeds that the optimizer eroded cannot be recovered from it.
readings: single hotspot circle, radius ≈3 elements, at a clamped root corner (x≈0, y≈0 or y≈L_y)
single hotspot circle near the load point (L_x, 0.5 L_y)
overlapping circle chain (radius ≈2 elements) along a stressed chord (widen-member action)
seed circle at a member–void junction plus a void in a low-stress zone (redistribute action)
several seed regions accumulated over up to 5 design steps

items.entity: seed density ρ̄_seed used in the soft-seed trace
items.description: The defaults are 0.85 for hotspot/redistribute and 0.80 for widen-member. However, the LLM may set this value, and realized values span 0.80–0.95 (Table 1; Sec. 3.5 'Choice of ρ̄_seed'). The value used in this trace is not reported.

items.entity: persistence of seed/frozen regions from earlier design steps
items.description: Eq. (5) re-initializes only S^(t), the 'seed elements proposed at step t'. However, the Modifier accumulates regions in P^(t+1), and Sec. 3.2 applies seeds 'before the first OC update of each solver call'. It is unclear which regions were active in the solve that produced the retained-best state.
readings: only the latest step's regions are applied
all regions accumulated in the specification are applied at every later solve

items.entity: controller-inserted voids (redistribute / insert-passive-void actions)
items.description: In Table 1, 'Redistribute material' voids a low-stress region and 'Insert passive void' is available. The text does not say whether either Fig. 2 trace added voids beyond the two benchmark voids, or where.
readings: none (only the two benchmark voids)
one extra circular void in a low-stress zone near a free right-hand corner (x≈0.9 L_x, y≈0.1 L_y or 0.9 L_y)
one extra void in the interior between the upper and lower load paths

items.entity: controller-changed filter radius / penalization in the retained steps
items.description: Table 1 and Sec. 3.4 let the controller tighten or loosen r_min and adjust p, possibly combined with spatial actions. Sec. 3.2 and 4.2, however, describe a standardized tail common to all conditions (p=4.5, r_min=1.2). The global actions realized in the two Fig. 2 traces are not reported, and neither is whether they persist into the tail.
readings: no r_min/p changes; standard schedule ending at p=4.5, r_min=1.2
controller changes affect only the main loop; the tail reverts to p=4.5, r_min=1.2
controller-set values persist into the retained state (e.g., r_min=1.5–2.0, p=3.0–4.0)

items.entity: density-filter radius schedule
items.description: Sec. 3.1/3.2 say r_min is 'tightened from its initial value toward r_min=1.2 during the late main loop'. The initial value, the timing of the tightening and the filter kernel are not given; the text says only 'three-field density filtering'.
readings: r_min,0 = 1.5 elements, reduced to 1.2 when β continuation starts
r_min,0 = 2.0 elements, reduced linearly to 1.2 over the last ~30 main-loop iterations
r_min,0 = 3.0 elements, reduced stepwise to 1.2 late in the main loop

items.entity: penalization continuation p: 1→4.5
items.description: Sec. 3.2 says 'p ramped from 1.0 to 4.5 over the main solve' and that β is doubled every 10 iterations after the ramp. The increment size, the update interval and the iteration at which the ramp ends are not given.
readings: p += 0.5 every 10 iterations (reaching 4.5 at iteration 70), then β doubled every 10 iterations to 32
p increased linearly from 1 to 4.5 over the first 60 iterations, then β doubling
p += 0.25 every 5 iterations, then β doubling

items.entity: Heaviside (tanh) projection threshold and constrained field
items.description: Sec. 3.1/3.2 specify tanh projection with β going 1→32 but give no projection threshold; the η=0.5 in Eq. 6 is the OC damping exponent, not the threshold. The text also does not say whether the volume constraint acts on the projected densities or on the design variables.
readings: threshold 0.5, volume constraint on projected physical densities
threshold 0.5, volume constraint on design (unprojected) variables
volume-preserving threshold found by bisection

items.entity: OC move limit in the main loop
items.description: Only the tail move limit (m=0.05) is given (Sec. 3.5, 4.2). The main-loop value is not stated.
readings: m = 0.05 (same as the tail)

items.entity: iteration budget per design step / stopping rule
items.description: Sec. 3.2 and 4.2 give a 'maximum 120 solver iterations per design step' plus a '40-iteration tail'. It is unclear whether the tail is part of the 120 and whether the main loop can stop early on a tolerance. The Table 2 convergence gate (n_iter ≤ 1.5 n_max) does not settle this.
readings: 120 main + 40 tail = 160 iterations per design step
120 total = 80 main + 40 tail
main loop stops early at a change tolerance (e.g., max|Δρ| < 0.01), then 40 tail iterations

items.entity: treatment of passive void/solid elements in the three-field filter/projection
items.description: Sec. 3.5 locks void and solid elements and excludes them from the OC update. It does not say whether the lock applies to design variables only or is re-imposed on the filtered and projected physical densities.
readings: lock on design variables only; physical densities may blur across region boundaries
lock re-imposed on physical (filtered + projected) densities after filtering
passive elements excluded from the filter neighbourhoods of active elements

items.entity: reference compliance labels in Fig. 2 (C=91.5, C=115.2)
items.description: The Fig. 2 caption calls the panels 'seed-42 examples'. However, the labels equal the three-seed means in Table 10 (115.2/91.5) and Table 4 (115.17 ± 1.01). It is therefore unclear which target a rerun should match.
readings: labels are the seed-42 retained-best values
labels are three-seed means; the seed-42 soft-seed value may differ by ≈1
